push.title: L 3-5 vs Gøøcastle Utd | You: 7.9
push.body:
A 7.9, buddskees. That's a sturdy front porch of a performance. We can build a house on it.

THE GOOD
+ 2 key passes. Chance creation is generosity with a soccer ball.
+ PhogsToffees finished what you started. That's teamwork.
+ 10th straight match at 7.5 match rating. I see you, and I like what I see.
+ Fewest misplaced passes on the team (4). Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.
+ Team-high 3 tackles attempted. I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Mark my words: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. That's the whole secret.
- Tackle success 0%, down from your usual 44%. Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 18 (best was PhogsToffees's 21). Remember this: Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for.
- Their humans averaged 8.8 to our 7.5; we were second best man for man. We win together and we wear this together.
- That loss cost us one of our chances in Division 3. We'll talk about it as a group, then leave it behind us.

Rondo time: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

Hey, buddskees. You miss every pass you don't make, and some you do. Make 'em anyway.

You're closer than you think. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 3-5 vs Gøøcastle Utd | You: 7.7
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.7 is a quiet night. Quiet nights are where we learn to be loud.

THE GOOD
+ 6 shots at Gøøcastle Utd's goal. Shoot your shot. You did, over and over.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 2. That doesn't happen by accident.
+ 3rd straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's a habit, and habits win leagues.
+ Team-high 16 completed passes. That's growth you can count.
+ 5 goals conceded: +0.2 to your rating. Keep stacking those.

THE BAD
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 3. Mind this: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
- Their humans averaged 8.8 to our 7.5; we were second best man for man. That's the scoreboard being honest with us.
- Pass accuracy: 76%. Let's make 88%+ the habit.
- Shots on target: 67%. The good neighborhood starts at 90%+.
- Key passes: 1. Good. Great starts at 2+.

Skill builder: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.

PhogsToffees, take this with you: Believe it, then go do it.

Every great player has nights like this. Most of 'em just don't get a note from me. - Coach Lasso
